name: Hathor
body:
As the Lady of Love and Joy, Hathor promotes peaceful interactions through love of family and joyful celebration of the arts.

Joys

Hathor appears as a human female with the head of a cow. A moon disc rests between the cow’s long horns. Hathor is the inspiration behind artists of all kinds, including musicians, dancers, painters, potters, sculptors, poets, and thespians.

Muse

Granted Powers: You can inspire your allies to achieve heroic victories and deliver exquisite performances. When first selecting this domain, a cleric can choose to use their Charisma as their spellcasting ability modifier rather than their Wisdom. This choice is optional and final—it can’t be changed.

Touch of Perfection (Sp)

You can touch a creature as a standard action to increase the save DC of the next spell it casts. The save DC increases by 1, and the spell must be cast within 1 minute or the boon is wasted. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Stunning Beauty (Su)

At 8th level, when you make a successful melee attack, you can use a swift action to stare your target in the eye. The target must make a Will saving throw DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). On a failed save, the target is stunned for 1 round plus 1 round for every five cleric levels you possess. On a successful save, the target is dazed for 1 round instead. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-crafter’s fortune, 2nd-timely inspiration, 3rd-bestow insight, 4th-gallant inspiration, 5th-serenity, 6th-joyful rapture, 7thbrilliant inspiration, 8th-euphoric tranquility, 9th-wish.
